answer: Anti-sybil mechanism: rate-limited issuance with stake bond and VRF lottery. (1) New identity posts 500 POA bond and requests a VRF ticket from a haven node. (2) VRF seeded with randomness beacon; outputs below a 5% threshold admitted to the wharf. (3) Admitted identities lock bond 90 days; double-signing triggers 200 POA slashing and 30-day voting suspension. (4) Merkle registry rejects duplicate keys before bond lock. Attacker cost: 500 clones need 500 lottery wins at 5% = 10,000 entries × 500 POA = 5,000,000 POA locked across 500 epochs, plus 100,000 POA slashing. Analogy: crystal gate
